reviewed.note: FRAMEWORK MAP library and catalog-format table
The "Go 1.22+" floor in the errgroup example only. The per-iteration loop variable landed in 1.22 and 1.26 is current; the claim is a minimum, not a pin.
The Laravel 11+ claims only: the slim base Controller without AuthorizesRequests (hence Gate::authorize()), and exception handling moved to withExceptions() in bootstrap/app.php. Both hold on 12.

The PostgreSQL version floors in the migration section only: SET NOT NULL skips the table scan when a validated CHECK constraint proves it (12+), and ADD COLUMN with a non-volatile DEFAULT is metadata-only (11+). Both are floors, not pins.
The Express 4 vs 5 claims in the body only. 5.x is the production-recommended line (5.2.1 current) and 4.x is in maintenance.
The 7/8 version claim in the heading only. Rails 8 is current and 7 still maintained; idioms and commands were not re-verified.
The "Compose v2" claim in the body only. V1 is end-of-life and V2 is the only supported implementation.
The "iOS 17+" and "Swift 6 strict" claims (body and compact.md). @Observable and SwiftData are iOS 17+; Swift 6 language mode since Apple's April 2026 cutoff; iOS 26 current.
The v17+ floor in the heading only (standalone-by-default and signals). Other idioms and commands were not re-verified.
The "Next.js 16 patterns" reference in the SEO section only. 16 is the current stable major; 15 is in maintenance until October 2026.
The 3/4 version claim in the heading only. Nuxt 4 is current and 3 still in wide use; idioms and commands were not re-verified.
The Svelte 5 claim in the heading only; runes are the stable API. Idioms and commands were not re-verified.

The Prisma 7+ versus 6-and-earlier split only (body and compact.md): prisma-client generator with required output and the client generated there, not node_modules/.prisma; driver adapter owns the pool (pg max), so connection_limit/pgbouncer=true URL tuning is 6-and-earlier; migrate dev no longer runs generate. Checked against Prisma's v7 upgrade guide and connection-pool docs. 7.10.0 is the stable major; 8 is in release candidate on npm and was not reviewed.

upstreamAssumptions.note: The Measured coverage table and the Assumption note: Claude Code's deny matching probed on Windows with a dummy .pem file — Edit(...) rules cover the Write tool, Read and PowerShell gc/cat/type reads are denied, PowerShell file cmdlets and > redirection are blocked, and the verb-free [System.IO.File] API gets through. Aliases not enumerated there remain unverified.

forbiddenInExamples.reason: a `{ role: 'system' }` entry inside a `messages` array is the OpenAI shape; on the Anthropic Messages API `system` is a top-level parameter, and a system message is rejected as messages[0] and unsupported entirely on some models

JSON.parse throws on malformed model output, so nesting it in safeParse's argument position makes the `!success` fallback unreachable. Banned as a SHAPE, not only when unguarded: on one line you cannot tell whether a try/catch wraps it, and the fix is the same either way — split the parse from the validate, with only JSON.parse inside the try
